pictures.scene: Joseph Anton Koch, Noah's Thank Offering — the family kneeling with lifted arms at the stone altar as the smoke goes up from the hill, a Psalm of thanksgiving
pictures.name: pd_koch_dank

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Niagara Falls, from the American Side — the whole river going over in thunder and spray, make a joyful noise to the LORD all the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_aarde

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, The Concert — singers leaning in over the open music books by candlelight, serve the LORD with gladness and come into His presence with joyful songs
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_zingen

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, The Sheepfold, Moonlight — the shepherd holding the hurdle open while the whole flock crowds in under the moon, it is He who made us and we are His, the sheep of His pasture
pictures.name: pd_millet_kudde

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Amsterdam — the congregation gathered in the sunlit nave around the pulpit, enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise
pictures.name: pd_witte_poorten

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, Das Tischgebet — the poor family standing with folded hands at the bare table while Christ blesses the bread, give thanks to Him and bless His name
pictures.name: pd_uhde_zegen

pictures.scene: Govert Flinck, Isaac Blessing Jacob — the blind old man laying his hand on the son's head and passing the blessing on, His faithfulness continues to all generations
pictures.name: pd_flinck_geslacht

lines.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD,
come into His presence with joyful songs.
Know that the LORD is God.
It is He who made us, and we are His;
we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
give thanks to Him and bless His name.
and His loving devotion endures forever;
His faithfulness continues to all generations.
